files.approvals.json: model scenarios: who may approve (5.7), host events (5.2, 5.12), gate.incomplete, gate.not_applicable, a stale source_sha
files.chain.json: [shared, unchanged] three chained events: heads, prev, canonical lines, signing bytes; the sig and host_sig values in it are PLACEHOLDERS, real signatures are pinned in signatures.json, tamper.json and the scenarios
files.checkpoint.json: checkpoint objects, signed bytes, refusals, divergence (5.10); receiver checks with valid signatures: pinned delegation, owner-device policy, signed source, line binding, abandoned, T head, position time, clock ceiling, revoked signers, ticket restores, trust root and strict shape
files.devices.json: device.added rules: drop: and scope refusals, self-signed, stale roster_v, recovery (5.3, 5.11)
files.effective_policy.json: the 5.7 intersection, a later workspace change, gate.no_eligible
files.gate_hash.json: [shared, CHANGED] gate hash known answers; every inner hash is derived from the `ticket` each case ships (5.6, 5.7), with real policy names, people roles and `prior`
files.generation.json: the 5.7 raise table row by row, delayed approval, reverted edit, voided approvals
files.genesis.json: the six genesis checks in order (5.11)
files.hashes.json: [shared, CHANGED] known answers: artifact, section, value, policy, people, question id, grant secret; refused non-NFC inputs (5.6); refused non-canonical policies (5.7); #1123: the question hash over the whole question (kinds choice and text, spec), refused question shapes, answer rules, the pinned fold and blank sets (5.6.1)
files.labels.json: [shared, CHANGED] the F1 domain labels (5.6), prefix-free with the protocol's; H12d adds sig_reader_decl
files.phone_events.json: [shared, new] phone person events over relay.submit (orch-v2-host 11A.14, H12e): question.answered and ticket.created signed by a phone of sev (dk_sevp1, look+decide), secure-enclave-unlocked and passphrase; per accepted case the submitted form, signing bytes, digest, sig, appended event and head; refusals (question.stale, members.stale, event.bad_base, sig.invalid, device.scope, event.duplicate_id, ticket.exists, an abandoned answer replayed); high-s; a blocking-only re-ask; A -> B -> A then a delayed A answer
files.questions.json: question id and hash, answers, a decision for the same qid after a restore; #1123 `forms`: one choice and one text question as raw event, read-view item and hub needs, each with its hash (5.6.1)
files.reader_kat_1.json: [shared, new] the reader known-answer test of H12d (orch-v2-host 0.8.6 item 9.2): the log variant (three independently signed, separately replayable workspace events differing only in auth), the view variant (READER_VIEWS_1) and the expected level-1 digests (11.5)
files.refusal_order.json: model scenarios: an event breaking two rules gets the code of the earlier step of the refusal order (5.11)
files.replay.json: model scenario: replayed or re-contexted signed events are refused with the real verifier (5.3, 5.11)
files.repo_identity.json: [shared, extended] canonical identities, refused forms, and `mapping`: raw remote -> canonical (5.7)
files.repo_paths.json: repo paths: NFC before ASCII-only collision comparison; owner-signed paths may leave the workspace (1, 11.3)
files.restore.json: workspace restore carries effective revocations atomically (5.10); re-signed structural refusals; host self-revocation
files.revocation.json: device.revoked: embedded revocation as authority, reason mismatch, recovery (5.3)
files.section_text.json: body.md heading and fence rules, LF trimming, what is hashed (4, 5.6)
files.signatures.json: real P-256 signatures of events and host_sig, what they cover, replay refusals (5.3, 5.5)
files.status.json: the 5.9 status table, done is sticky, reopen, a new sha under a case-variant remote
files.tamper.json: tampered chain lines of the ticket and workspace log, the seq where the chain breaks (5.5)
files.text.json: [shared, CHANGED] CRLF/CR -> LF, NFC (Unicode 16.0), refused controls, bidi and unassigned (11.3); H12e (orch-v2-host 11A.14 14.8) adds LF kept and code points unassigned in 16.0 but assigned in Unicode 17.0 (a phone with newer tables must refuse them before the sign sheet)

note: files tagged [shared] are copied verbatim into orch-relay; the others are core-only. Step keys: replay_only accepts historical replay but admit refuses chain.bad_ws_seq; schema_refused means schema validation refuses before the model; append_code pins the store append refusal (F1 §5.11 step 0), while expect keeps the model outcome; replay_expect pins a distinct replay outcome.
